02 / THE IDEA

Separate what is shared
from what is directional.

The acoustic scene is the same for every requested speaker. We reuse its representation and introduce the steering information only when estimating target-specific beamforming weights.

Multichannel mixtureSix microphones · one scene
→
RUN ONCEShared front endTarget-direction-agnostic features
→
ALightweight head+ steering direction A→
BSame head parameters+ steering direction B→
…One head evaluation per requested target
LATE STEERING-VECTOR FUSION

One reusable representation. A variable number of requested directions. No repeated evaluation of the expensive front end.

P95 software output delay

Three requested targets, 10 ms input packets, and a single CPU thread.

20 msSTFT / overlap-add input buffering
4.20 msSeparately measured packet-processing P95

Output delay includes buffering, computation, and scheduling. Processing P95 is measured separately; percentiles are not additive.

Read the runtime protocol +

Intel Core i9-10900; one pinned logical CPU; one intra-operation and one inter-operation thread. Offline RTF: batch size one, a 1-second six-channel input, 10 warm-ups, and the median of 40 timed runs. Streaming: a warm-loaded stateful pipeline with causal gain estimation, three paced replays of one 10-second recording. The median of the three per-trial P95 delays is reported. File/model loading, DOA estimation, and audio-device/ADC/DAC buffers are excluded. These timings are independent of the prerecorded listening outputs above.

04 / BEYOND THE SELECTED EXAMPLES

A view of the
full test set.

Across 370 original two-source test configurations and four nominal array SNRs, matched late fusion improves mean SI-SDR over early fusion.

These aggregate results provide context for the curated listening examples. Closely spaced sources remain challenging: mean SI-SDR is negative at 10° separation. Late fusion does not lead every quality metric.

Array SNR compares the summed fully reverberant speech with additive noise, averaged over time and all six microphones. It is not a fixed per-target TNR.
